notes: five branches: four «ح» and one «جميعا»; «كل هؤلاء عن سلمة بن كهيل» is written once after them all, so Salama is the shared tail
Sufyan is written once after «جميعا» and belongs to the two branches it joins (Waki' and Ibn Numayr's father); both list him
«أبي» in the Ibn Numayr branch is his father, bare: relation
the wording remarks («نحو حديث شعبة», «ثلاثة أحوال», «وزاد سفيان في رواية وكيع», «وفي رواية ابن نمير») name no new transmitter and are left out
